review.why: A measurement-led browser performance workflow with network, trace and source-code investigation.
review.summary: Complements visual design and React patterns with measured loading and interaction evidence. Falls back honestly when trace tools are missing. A source or accessibility snapshot alone cannot measure contrast or field performance.
cautions: Chrome DevTools MCP needed for full trace workflow
A single lab trace is not field Core Web Vitals
Verify thresholds and supported tools against current docs
